TXT_CODE_DAEMON_PLUGIN_ESSENTIAL_DISABLE: The web server cannot be disabled remotely: the panel would lose the connection it manages this daemon over. Set plugins.server.enabled to false in its data/plugin-overrides.json on the host instead.
TXT_CODE_DAEMON_PLUGIN_SELF_DISABLE: Plugin management cannot disable itself: the panel would lose the events it administers this daemon with. Set plugins.config.enabled to false in its data/plugin-overrides.json on the host instead.
